topics.title: Understanding Percent as "Out of 100"
topics.concept:
What is Percent?

Percent means "per hundred" (cent = 100 in Latin). The symbol % means "out of 100."

  • 50% = 50 out of 100 = 50/100 = ½
  • 25% = 25 out of 100 = 25/100 = ¼
  • 100% = all of it = 1 whole

Real-Life Examples:

  • "I got 90% on my test" = answered 90 out of 100 correctly
  • "This shirt is 20% off" = save 20 for every100
  • "75% of students like pizza" = 75 out of 100 students

topics.title: Finding Percent of a Quantity
topics.concept:
Three Methods to Find Percent of a Number:

Method 1: Convert to Decimal

  • 20% of 60 = 0.2 × 60 = 12

Method 2: Use Fraction

  • 20% = (1)/(5), so (1)/(5) of 60 = 12

Method 3: Use Proportion

  • 20/100 = x/60
  • Cross multiply: 100x = 1200, x = 12

Real-World Applications:

  • Sales tax: 8% tax on 50 = 0.08 × 50 =4
  • Tips: 15% tip on 40 = 0.15 × 40 =6
  • Discounts: 25% off 80 = 0.25 × 80 =20 saved
